ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 20% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Densely distributed high-contrast white annular and solid circular blobs, ranging from 5 to 25 pixels in diameter, mapped across the dark field; higher cluster density is observed on the medial and outer lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 38 degrees; vertical notch depth is approximately 15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge; irregular peak-to-valley pixel amplitude varies from 4 to 12 pixels; serrations are most pronounced and sharpest on the outer thirds of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a convex curvature sweeping upward toward the distal tips; lateral outer edges display a smooth concave curve where they intersect the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive mapping of circular high-contrast pixel rings (rosettes) across both lobes; high-density clusters are particularly prominent on the central-medial region of the left lobe and the lower-medial region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single distinct vertical linear pixel disruption, approximately 50 pixels in length, is visible approximately 12 pixels to the right of the median notch axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, protruding clusters of textured, multi-tonal pixels (beige, white, and dark grey) are located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; extensive circular scarring covers the majority of the visible dark integument.
